status.summary: The 2 November council minutes continue to describe the named Lightedge proposal and explicitly say Boone has not been finally selected. The 19 October site-plan and MOU votes are documented planning actions; a future development agreement and construction-permit process remain. No achieved construction, completed facility or operational customer deployment is inferred.

locator.precision: Exact numbered-address match from the US Census Bureau geocoder for 1920 Lakewood Drive, the campus address in the council approval and submitted site plan. The point is interpolated on TIGER street edge 64944389, side L, range 1900–1998; it locates the campus address, not a building footprint or property boundary. The proposal combines 1920, 1940 and 2000 Lakewood Drive. Census documents its output as NAD83. The point was explicitly transformed from EPSG:4269 to EPSG:4326 using EPSG:1188, NAD83 to WGS 84 (1), in pyproj 3.8.0, then rounded to seven decimals. This zero-translation operation leaves the numbers unchanged; its published operation accuracy is 4 m, not the overall accuracy of this street-address locator. No exact datum equivalence or survey precision is asserted.
locator.identity_review: No exact Lakewood address, Edge Boone, Boone Edge or parcel-prefix match in baseline sites.csv, projects.csv, identity-mapping.json or source-records.json. Lightedge matches only the existing Altoona DSM1/DSM2 campus, 53.09 km away. Boone mentions in that project are the economic-development source discussing a different proposal; the other Boone match is Meta in Boone County, Indiana. Ames matches are Ames Construction on Microsoft Ohio projects, not an Ames Iowa host. The nearest baseline site is Apple Waukee, 46.26 km away, followed by Meta Altoona, 50.63 km. No baseline host is within 2 km. The three contiguous numbered-address lots form one proposed host with two staged buildings, not three new sites. The separate Ames alternative is not counted as another addition.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Census provides no horizontal accuracy for this address-range interpolation or distance from it to the proposed buildings. Datum realization and coordinate epoch are unspecified. EPSG:1188 has a 4 m operation accuracy, which does not quantify the unmeasured address-interpolation or facility-offset uncertainty; overall horizontal uncertainty remains unknown.

status_updates.identity_review: The retained imported record is Core Scientific Denton on Jim Christal Road, with CoreWeave as its colocation customer. The April issuer filing identifies the campus at 8171 Jim Christal Road; the government TDLR records separately identify its north and south parcel support facilities at 8161. Both name the Core Scientific Denton campus and City of Denton ownership. The exact 8161 government point anchors this existing multi-building campus. No address renumbering, identical entrance or specific hall coordinate is asserted; 8161 and 8171 remain separately reported address references.
